|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB4-90E-Tusken_Breath_Mask-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tusken Breath Mask (V) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) changed “your ability” to “your total ability” (the card-list entry is marked “Errata Text - September 9th, 2009”, but the 7 December 2009 release sheet still prints the original text): “Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, may add X to your total ability during battle at a site. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.”.<ref name="cl-1240_92-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
